# Synthetic artifact TLS fixtures

This directory contains a local test-only CA certificate, localhost/127.0.0.1 server certificate, and the corresponding test-only PKCS8 server key. They have no production trust or credentials. Testroots are injected only inside artifact_source unit tests; native SourcePolicy uses the packaged public Mozilla roots and has no certificate bypass or public custom-root API.

Generated by local OpenSSL/LibreSSL using P-256 ECDSA and SHA256. Leaf SAN: localhost/127.0.0.1. Wronghostname and untrustedchain checks use the same fixture without relaxing native validation. All network tests bind loopback only. Private CA signing key and generation scratch are not shipped.
